name: send-schedule-field
title: Send schedule field
description: Send now or later: two choices, a day and time that open for later, the time zone in words, and a sentence saying exactly when it goes out.
docs: value is { mode, at }: mode is "now" or "later", and at is an ISO time with an offset ("2026-10-27T09:00:00+01:00"), or null while the day or the time is missing or was refused. The two choices are a real radio group, so the arrow keys move and choose. Schedule opens the house Date time picker, read in timeZone (an IANA name; the offset comes from the zone at that moment, daylight saving included). A time sooner than now plus minLeadMinutes is refused with a message that names the earliest time that works, and is reported as at: null so a Send button can wait. A sentence in a polite live region always says the result: "Goes out Tue 27 Oct at 09:00, Europe/Amsterdam, in 3 days". now fixes the clock for tests and previews; without it the field reads the browser clock after the page has loaded, so the server and the browser agree, and again every half minute. minuteStep sets the times in the list, locale the language of the dates and of "in 3 days", labels renames every word.
